spell.druid.evokes_roots.name: Evoke Roots
spell.druid.evokes_roots.description: Evoke Roots under an enemy target to damage it over time and slow it down
spell.druid.poisonous_thorn.name: Poisonous Thorn
spell.druid.poisonous_thorn.description: Sting an enemy with a big thorn that deals {damage} spell power and poisoning the target, stronger the spell power stronger the poison
spell.druid.leaves_tornado.name: Leaves Tornado
spell.druid.leaves_tornado.description: Summon a powerful tornado of leaves from the tip of the caster staff dealing up to {damage} spell damage for second
spell.druid.spiky_vines.name: Spiky Vines
spell.druid.spiky_vines.description: Summon poisonous vines in the area before the caster dealing up to {damage} spell damage for second poisoning the target, stronger the spell power stronger the poison
